outcome.failureOutput: WHOBROKEIT_BUG: expected header=["foo"] and _=["bar"], but got header=["foo","bar"] and _=[]

explanation.why: `yargs.js` (`_parseArgs`) passes the parser configuration to `yargs-parser`. The `yargs-parser@17` upgrade added a `greedy-arrays` setting that defaults to true. With that default, `eatArray` runs for any `array` option and consumes every following non-flag argument. `eatArray` is also checked before `eatNargs`, so `nargs: 1` on an array option is ignored. In 15.1.0 and `yargs-parser@16`, an array with `nargs` took only `nargs` values, so `--header foo bar` gave `header=['foo']` and `_=['bar']`. The earlier attempt did not work because it used the key `greedy-array` (singular), and the parser reads `greedy-arrays`.
